description: The organization's plan and subscription: plan, status, when the period renews or ends, whether it is set to cancel, the price, this month's use of every limit (units, described areas, API keys, rate) and what the next plan adds, with its checkout_url. Free. The same as get_account without the profile. Call it before suggesting an upgrade, and after handing a human a checkout link to see when the payment went through (plan changes from free to the plan bought, usually within seconds). Needs an API key or a connected account.
name: get_subscription
title: Get subscription
